itens.titulo: Elliptic analytics say North Korea launders stolen Binance funds via homemade meme coins
itens.resumo: North Korea is laundering cryptocurrency stolen from Binance through homemade meme coins, according to blockchain analytics firm Elliptic, describing it as a scheme designed to resemble ordinary trading and delay investigators.

itens.titulo: Moolenaar urges next Congress to continue bipartisan China committee amid questions over its future
itens.resumo: John Moolenaar, chairman of the House Select Committee on China, in a statement released November 9, urged the next Congress to renew the panel’s mandate, saying it should continue its bipartisan work on China policy when lawmakers return early next year.
